Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase should come before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，To describe pretending to carry out an action, use the verb pattern with 假装 or 装作; 装 cannot directly introduce this action in this way. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈：妈妈带着他，This wording means that 孟子 moved together with his mother. When the mother takes her child to relocate, use 带着孟子搬家. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。：有一个小男孩叫孟子；他小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。, On first mention, introduce the character with both a name and a clear identity; later, use a pronoun for the recently mentioned character. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，This relocation is a completed past event, so the final action verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不对，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达该意思。
“跟妈妈搬家”正确，表示孟子和妈妈一起搬家。
人物首次出现时需要先较清楚地介绍孟子是谁。
孟子在紧接的前一句刚出现，按该规则这里应使用“他”。
这里说的是过去已经完成的搬家事件，应说“搬家了”。
